subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should be shown directly to users, and what redaction rule should apply to session/channel identifiers?
rationale: Current code already has provider/model, effective budget, estimated or observed count, overage, route, and session facts in logs or state, but exposing exact counts and identifiers is a UX and privacy policy choice.

options.title: Show redacted diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective limit or budget, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep specifics operator-only
options.body: Leave chat-visible copy generic and document the log, status, or diagnostic commands operators should use to inspect context-pressure details.

options.title: Fold into broader context visibility
options.body: Defer visible overflow specifics until a broader design chooses consistent UI, status, logs, and channel-message behavior for context pressure.

recommendation.title: Show redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective limit or budget, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.
